race.description: Pogson Cronin Kerr Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: IKON PARK (4) made an encouraging debut last time out finishing third at Wagga. Comes in fresh with a month between runs and keeps gun hoop in Loy. Can get off the mark this time. DISTANT STRIPES (3) finished third last start over 1300m at Forbes to make it six minor placings from 12 runs. Yet to miss the top-three in two runs at this circuit. A maiden win looks imminent. REDS EXPRESS (5) was doing her best work late last start to grab third at Forbes. Drawn sticky so expect her to drift back early and be charging hard late. CONARGO (1) was prominent at the corner and finished second last time over 1175m at this track, beaten half a length. Improved sharply last time and has more to offer third-up.
